title: Calculate Average Salary by Department
learning_objective: Learn how to group employees by department and calculate average salary.

tutorial.explanation: When a question asks for one answer per group, GROUP BY is usually the tool you need. Here, each department_id becomes one group, and AVG calculates one salary value inside each group.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;
tutorial.mental_model: GROUP BY creates one result row per department. AVG then looks only at the rows inside that department group.

guided_example.prompt: Find the average salary for each department.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;
guided_example.explanation: We group rows by department_id, then calculate the average salary inside each group.

practice.prompt: Find the total salary for each department.
practice.expected_query: SELECT department_id, SUM(salary) AS total_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;
